title: SHSP: Structure-Aware Hierarchical Solution Prediction for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2608.25282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is a fundamental optimization paradigm in combinatorial optimization and has been widely applied across real-world domains. Due to its NP-hard nature, obtaining optimal solutions for large-scale or highly constrained MILP instances remains computationally prohibitive. Learning-based solution prediction has therefore emerged as a promising approach to provide high-quality variable assignment for solver acceleration. However, existing methods typically adopt a one-shot prediction paradigm that predicts the marginal probabilities of all variables simultaneously. As a result, the conditional dependencies among variables are only implicitly captured through message passing, with the burden of modeling the combinatorial structure falling entirely on the representational capacity of graph neural networks. translated_title: SHSP：面向混合整数线性规划的结构感知分层解预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25282v1 公告类型：新 摘要：混合整数线性规划（MILP）是组合优化中的一种基本优化范式，已在现实世界领域得到广泛应用。由于其NP难性质，对于大规模或高度约束的MILP实例，获得最优解在计算上仍然难以实现。因此，基于学习的解预测已成为一种有前景的方法，可为求解器加速提供高质量的变量赋值。然而，现有方法通常采用一次性预测范式，同时预测所有变量的边际概率。结果，变量之间的条件依赖性仅通过消息传递隐式捕获，组合结构的建模负担完全落在图神经网络的表示能力上。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了结构感知分层解预测（SHSP）方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结构感知的分层解预测方法，通过显式建模变量间的条件依赖关系，克服了现有一次性预测在混合整数线性规划中难以捕捉组合结构的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-aware hierarchical solution prediction method that explicitly models conditional dependencies among variables, overcoming the limitation of existing one-shot prediction in capturing combinatorial structures for mixed-integer linear programming.
